sponsored.t: Requires electric scooter service platforms to maintain insurance coverage
sponsored.sum: Requires electric scooter service platforms to maintain liability insurance and provide proof of insurance.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "licensure incentives and fee-support for testing (LIFT) act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "licensure incentives and fee-support for testing (LIFT) act"; establishes the social work licensure examination voucher program to provide low-income individuals vouchers to cover the cost of the examination, regardless of the number of examination attempts, required for licensure as a licensed master social worker or licensed clinical social worker.

sponsored.t: Updates school concussion management and response protocols
sponsored.sum: Updates school concussion management and response protocols; requires that the injured student have returned to a full class schedule without academic accommodations prior to resuming athletic activity; authorizes physician assistants to evaluate pupils with concussions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state buy American cement act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York state buy American cement act" to require the use of American materials when soliciting for a contract for the purchase of cement by any department or agency of the state, municipality, public authority and the commissioner of transportation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of a qualified mental health professional for purposes of mobile crisis outreach teams
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of a "qualified mental health professional" to include licensed mental health counselors and licensed marriage and family therapists for the purposes of members of an approved mobile crisis outreach team.

sponsored.t: Allows certain persons to practice as a mental health practitioner under supervision for a certain period of time if application and fee requirements are met
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person with a master's level degree required for practicing as a mental health practitioner shall be allowed to practice under supervision for a period of up to ninety days after the submission of the required application and fees.

sponsored.t: Allows voters not enrolled in a political party to designate and vote in the primary election of a political party
sponsored.sum: Provides that at a primary election, a voter who is not enrolled in a political party may designate the ballot of one political party qualified to participate in such election and shall be provided with and permitted to vote only in the primary election of the political party so designated; excludes presidential primary elections.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Social Worker Initiative for Faster Testing (SWIFT) act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Social Worker Initiative for Faster Testing (SWIFT) act"; provides that with respect to the examination requirement for licensure as a master social worker, an applicant pursuing a master's of social work degree who is enrolled in the final semester of a program registered by the department of education or an educational program accredited or in candidacy for accreditation by the council on social work education shall be eligible to take the master's level examination.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certified school psychologists to participate in the certification of certain persons as intellectually disabled or developmentally disabled
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certified school psychologists to participate in the certification of certain persons as intellectually disabled or developmentally disabled; makes technical corrections to language.

sponsored.t: Relates to e-scooter mobile app disclosures
sponsored.sum: Prohibits electric scooter service platforms operating a digital network from operating electric scooters in this state unless such platform displays a warning that persons under 18 years of age are not allowed to operate electric scooters through the platform; imposes a penalty for violations.

sponsored.t: Defines mental health practitioners with diagnostic authority
sponsored.sum: Defines mental health practitioners with diagnostic authority for the purposes of providing services under the workers' compensation law; includes such practitioners as providers.

sponsored.t: Relates to school tax relief exemption notification
sponsored.sum: Provides that notification of the approval of a STAR exemption be mailed to the applicant within thirty days of such determination.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sealing of certain claims against law enforcement officers
sponsored.sum: Provides for the sealing of unfounded, exonerated, and pending claims made against law enforcement officers; requires such claims to be redacted from disciplinary records.

sponsored.t: Requires notices of liability issued for nonpayment of tolls to be uniform in form and content and contain specific information
sponsored.sum: Requires notices of liability issued for nonpayment of tolls to be uniform in form and content and contain information on monetary penalties, the public authority issuing the notice of liability and the rates, fees, or charges applicable to nonpayment of tolls.

sponsored.t: Establishes a certified community behavioral health clinic public awareness campaign
sponsored.sum: Establishes a certified community behavioral health clinic public awareness campaign to educate the public regarding certified community behavioral health clinics.

sponsored.t: Relates to supervision by certain marriage and family therapists and mental health counselors
sponsored.sum: Provides for supervision by certain marriage and family therapists and mental health counselors who meet certain experience requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensing of independent insurance adjusters
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensing of independent insurance adjusters by deeming requirements regarding a written examination met if the applicant holds a claim certification from a national or state-based claims association.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for nonpublic school safety equipment grants
sponsored.sum: Provides that reimbursement payable for grants for nonpublic school safety equipment shall be paid within twelve months of the nonpublic school furnishing all required application materials for such grant to the department of education; requires the commissioner of education to report on any such reimbursements payable.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending the duration of limited permits to practice licensed clinical social work and licensed master social work
sponsored.sum: Extends the duration of limited permits to practice licensed clinical social work and use the title licensed clinical social worker, or practice licensed master social work and use the title licensed master social worker from twelve to twenty-four months with the ability to be renewed for up to two additional one-year periods.

sponsored.t: Relates to health and social services practitioners included under the health care proxy law, the family health care decisions act, and nonhospital orders not to resuscitate
sponsored.sum: Adds licensed mental health counselors and licensed marriage and family therapists to the health and social services practitioners included under the health care proxy law, the family health care decisions act, and nonhospital orders not to resuscitate.

sponsored.t: Requires any website or mobile application associated with an electronic benefit transfer system to be offered in the twelve most common non-English languages
sponsored.sum: Requires any website or mobile application associated with an electronic benefit transfer system to be offered in the twelve most common non-English languages spoken by limited-English proficient individuals in the state, based on data in the most recent American Community Survey published by the United States Census Bureau.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "who you gonna call?  act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "who you gonna call? act"; classifies vehicles of the office of chief medical examiner of the city of New York as an emergency vehicle; classifies any actual or potential scene where the New York city office of chief medical examiner has an official role as an emergency operation; authorizes vehicles of the office of chief medical examiner of the city of New York to affix vehicles with blue, red and white lights.

sponsored.t: Relates to expenses in matrimonial actions
sponsored.sum: Relates to expenses in matrimonial actions; establishes there is a rebuttable presumption that certain itemized bills or invoices shall be admissible in evidence.

sponsored.t: Enhances protections for child performer trust accounts
sponsored.sum: Enhances protections for child performer trust accounts; establishes how much gross earnings shall be set aside for such child performer.

sponsored.t: Prohibits public adjusters from contacting certain persons regarding a property that has sustained damage from a damaging event within forty-eight hours of such damaging event
sponsored.sum: Prohibits public adjusters from initiating contact with, soliciting, or approaching owners, occupants, tenants, or other affected parties regarding commercial or residential property that has sustained damage from a damaging event within forty-eight hours following such damaging event; establishes reimbursement and written notice requirements for such adjusters.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Jonathan Grossman to apply for a recalculation of his retirement benefits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Jonathan Grossman to apply for a recalculation of his retirement benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to electric scooter programs and establishing the street and sidewalk infrastructure fund
sponsored.sum: Requires registration of electric scooter programs; establishes the street and sidewalk infrastructure fund for projects supporting the repair, maintenance, and improvement of streets, sidewalks, and related pedestrian infrastructure.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "military experience recognized for institutional transfer (MERIT) act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "military experience recognized for institutional transfer (MERIT) act"; grants academic credit for veterans with regard to SUNY and CUNY college credits for military learning, training, coursework and occupational experience.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "building retention and internship-to-degree graduate employment (BRIDGE) act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "building retention and internship-to-degree graduate employment (BRIDGE) act"; provides limited work permits for students in a master of social work program; establishes policies and procedures for such work permit.

sponsored.t: Divides the one hundred ninth precinct of the New York city police department into subdivisions
sponsored.sum: Divides the one hundred ninth precinct of the New York city police department into two separate subdivisions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain surcharges on credit or debit card transactions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain surcharges on certain credit or debit card transactions in the city of New York; provides that no agency or department of the city of New York, or any tribunal located therein, shall be authorized to impose a surcharge on a holder who elects to use a credit or debit card in lieu of payment by cash, check, or similar means to pay any fine, civil penalty, or fee owed.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption to the prohibition on tinted windows in automobiles for emergency ambulance service vehicles
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption to the prohibition on tinted windows in automobiles for emergency ambulance service vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic delivery of insurance notices
sponsored.sum: Allows for certain notices related to property/casualty insurance contracts under the vehicle and traffic law to be delivered by electronic means.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of health to include in annual reports information regarding the cost and increase in cost of certain prescription drugs
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to include in annual reports information regarding the cost and increase in cost of the ten prescription drugs on which the state expends the most money and which have had certain costs increased by fifty percent or more over the past five years or by ten percent or more during the previous calendar year.

sponsored.t: Establishes that instruction in financial education be provided to pupils in grades nine, ten, eleven or twelve
sponsored.sum: Establishes that instruction in financial education be provided to pupils in grades nine through twelve; establishes what should be included in such curriculum including the basics of financial planning, budgeting, borrowing, interest rates, personal insurance policies, etc.

sponsored.t: Relates to minority and women-owned business enterprise certification
sponsored.sum: Exempts small business enterprises that manufacture metal or vinyl windows and doors from certain employee limits and personal net worth limits for purposes of certification of a minority-owned business enterprise.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "dialogue and decorum act" which establishes the crime of disruption or disturbance of a lawful assembly
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "dialogue and decorum act" which establishes the crime of disruption or disturbance of a lawful assembly; makes such crime an unclassified misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Relates to notices of violation of the city of New York's solid waste recycling laws
sponsored.sum: Relates to notices of violation of the city of New York's solid waste recycling laws; requires a photograph of the alleged violation to be mailed with the ticket.

sponsored.t: Relates to the length of the pre-licensing course required of applicants for a driver's license
sponsored.sum: Provides that the course consisting of classroom driver training and highway safety instruction that is required of driver's license applicants shall be not more than six hours instead of five.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Supervising Upcoming Professionals for Practice in Official Roles in Therapy (SUPPORT) act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Supervising Upcoming Professionals for Practice in Official Roles in Therapy (SUPPORT) act"; provides that for licensure as a clinical social worker, an applicant may satisfy the experience requirements under supervision of a mental health practitioner who has been granted the privilege to diagnose and develop assessment-based treatment plans under article one hundred sixty-three of the education law.

sponsored.t: Restricts amplified sound from vehicles
sponsored.sum: Restricts amplified sound coming from motor vehicles; allows for exceptions for certain police vehicles and certain vehicles used for business or political purposes.

sponsored.t: Requires that the distinctive license plate numbers issued to the owner of a registered motor vehicle be changed within a week after such plates being stolen
sponsored.sum: Requires that the distinctive license plate numbers issued to the owner of a registered motor vehicle be changed and the registration record for such motor vehicle be updated to reflect such change within a week after such plates being stolen.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle in the first degree when such person commits the offense of aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle in the third degree and causes the death or serious physical injury of another person.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of mental health care provider for purposes of certain sex offenses committed during a treatment session, consultation, interview, or examination
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of mental health care provider to include licensed psychoanalysts, creative arts therapists and behavior analysts for purposes of certain sex offenses committed during a treatment session, consultation, interview, or examination.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Honoring Our Pledge to Eliminate Antisemitism (HOPE) act"
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies and courts to take into consideration the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance's definition and contemporary examples of antisemitism when reviewing, investigating, or deciding whether there has been a violation of any non-criminal or criminal law, rule, or policy prohibiting discriminatory acts.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic delivery of notices
sponsored.sum: Provides that electronic notice to a party is sufficient in certain workers' compensation claims.

sponsored.t: Relates to the expiration of vehicle registrations
sponsored.sum: Provides that vehicle registrations, reregistrations and renewals shall expire upon the last day of the month in which the registration is valid.

sponsored.t: Limits the amount such fine to be paid for violating the E-ZPass system for failing to pay a toll
sponsored.sum: Limits the amount of the fine to be paid for violating the E-ZPass system for failing to pay a toll to not exceed the amount of such unpaid toll.

sponsored.t: Relates to rotary and roundabout use and safety awareness
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish the "rotary and roundabout use and safety awareness" component for the pre-licensing class as a prerequisite for obtaining a license to operate a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit for the installation of certain fire sprinkler systems
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for the installation of fire sprinkler systems for residential properties.

sponsored.t: Relates to New York state active duty
sponsored.sum: Relates to New York state active duty performed under the authority of the governor of New York state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the justice center to create a central registry for employees
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the justice center to create a central registry for employees for all current and prospective agencies, sponsoring agencies or other providers of services that are certified, authorized, approved or funded through contract by the office for people with developmental disabilities to streamline criminal background checks.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York State buy North American act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York State buy North American act" which requires the state, municipalities, public authorities and covered affordable housing projects to award contracts for the supply of manufactured products used in building projects to bidders who produce such manufactured products used in building projects primarily in North America; defines terms; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Allows for reasonable accommodations for the examination portion of licensure requirements to become a social worker for individuals for whom English is not their primary language
sponsored.sum: Allows for reasonable accommodations for the examination portion of licensure requirements to become a social worker for individuals for whom English is not their primary language and a test in their primary language is not available.

sponsored.t: Provides school preference when a student is applying to the same public elementary or middle school as a sibling
sponsored.sum: Provides that in a city with a population of one million or more, where a student is applying to attend a public elementary or middle school and such student has a sibling who already attends such school, such student whose application is pending shall be given preference for admission.

sponsored.t: Requires local community review and approval prior to the implementation of electric scooter programs and installation of electric scooter infrastructure in N.Y. City
sponsored.sum: Requires local community review and approval prior to the implementation of electric scooter programs and installation of electric scooter infrastructure in cities with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Makes aggravated cruelty to animals a class E felony; repealer
sponsored.sum: Makes aggravated cruelty to animals a class E violent felony offense; defines terms; makes technical changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to schedule rating plans reflecting individual risk characteristics of an employer
sponsored.sum: Relates to schedule rating plans reflecting individual risk characteristics of an employer.

sponsored.t: Requires the disclosure of certain members of student clubs and organizations to the college at which the club or organization is located
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of the name and contact information of at least one president, treasurer, and social media manager of certain student clubs and organizations to the college at which the club or organization is located.

sponsored.t: Makes technical corrections relating to the title of the commissioner of veterans' services
sponsored.sum: Makes technical corrections relating to the title of the commissioner of veterans' services.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 3403 of the insurance law relating to anti-arson applications
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to mandatory anti-arson applications for insurance coverage to insure any building against the peril of fire or explosion.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Ignazio Giacalone act" to provide additional credits to children and siblings of deceased New York city sanitation members
sponsored.sum: Provides additional credits to children and siblings of New York city sanitation members who died in the performance of duty as the natural and proximate result of the World Trade Center attack on September 11, 2001.

sponsored.t: Requires electronic benefit transfer systems to allow for benefit recipients to provide certain services when fraud has been suspected or reported
sponsored.sum: Requires electronic benefit transfer systems to allow for benefit recipients to cancel, lock or unlock a card associated with electronic benefit transfer services when fraud has been suspected or reported; amends the effectiveness thereof.
